about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos and clips run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); portrait is the then/now card (1080x1350, the feed's tallest post): the two photos sit inside the margin with the title band under them, so no word covers a photo.
